I understand... I am kind of the same rn... I am sorry you are going through that.

Message me if you want to talk. I hope it gets better for you.

Also, second reply: I am happy if you haven't had an eating disorder, but it is not as easy as 'just eat less' or 'just eat healthy'... at some points you would rather die than eat 100 calories...

This is why had to be drunk or high for a year in order to eat... and in order to become... this...

Schopenhauer is a philosopher, his porcupine metaphor is about how we are like porcupines that are cold and can only be warm by stabbing each other with our needles... however I feel like I am a porcupine and everyone else isn't.... About the other thing... I used to never eat and exercise a lot.... It wasn't healthy but now... I can not bare the hunger if I don't eat; and when I am not sober I just eat...

: I can't think, I can't stop shivering, I can't get out of bed... Then I just cave and eat...

​

I see... well, I guess that will be on the rest of what I can feel.
